row_matching: scope and alternate rows by normalized description plus candidate-defined ID; row order and the literal private IDs are not scored; summary fields by labeled template cells
identity_policy: candidate-defined non-empty unique scope IDs; IDs must join Line_Items, Alternates, and Provenance
header_policy: typed Excel dates and semantically equal readable dates are accepted; header text is compared case-insensitively after whitespace normalization
formula_policy: standard equivalent Excel formula strategies, including SUMIF/SUMIFS and percentage literals, are replayed from dependencies rather than matched to reference formula text
page_policy: the source page may be a number or a readable page label such as p. 1 or page 1
provenance_policy: the joined provenance row must identify the correct supplied scan, page, and a non-empty readable locator; exact private locator strings and a specific locator-cell format are not required
